verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a FireHydrant REST API with token-based API keys, a read-only endpoint, and an OpenAPI document published in the MCP repo. Nothing in the pack describes API versioning or a deprecation or sunset policy. API versioning is a fair question for a SaaS platform, so the absence of evidence is 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
